task: Deepen bank-statement-pdf-to-csv: fix the six transtractor rows the 2026-11-11 eval left wrong, with general rules, and measure on a held-out fixture

doc_friction.issue: The top Deepen rows are mostly 'needs a real outside input' items, so a session spends several minutes finding a buildable item. A short 'buildable here' list per flagship would save that time.

deviations.why: The router picked chant-forge (flagship 11), and every open item there needs a person to listen or sing. Following the brief's ROI emphasis, I took bank-statement-pdf-to-csv instead: a category with paying incumbents (DocuClipper, BankStatementConverter) and a measurable open item in its own eval README.
deviations.did: Fixed the transtractor fixture's six wrong rows with four general rules plus spacing-aware descriptions
deviations.result: 56 -> 62 of 62 rows right and balances proved; held-out test1a went from unbalanced to proved; benchmark 5/5 and ICICI 100/100 unchanged

goal: Revenue-category product depth: a statement converter that reads more real layouts and explains its own failures
